propositions: PreToolUse hook on Bash tool must emit a non-blocking reminder when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, to re-surface Serena symbol-search availability
Hook reminder message must be 2-3 lines, name find_referencing_symbols as preferred path, and document the exceptions (string literals, line numbers) where grep is correct
Hook must emit JSON to hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext without permissionDecision field, ensuring the reminder surfaces to the model and the call remains non-blocking
Trigger logic must use simple grep-family string matching with no pattern classification, path heuristics, or command parsing to avoid fragile misfires
scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py must be a tracked, testable script that can be executed directly against PreToolUse stdin envelope for automated verification
.claude/settings.json changes must merge the hooks block without overwriting existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting from dependency story C
